title: Draft Enhanced README.md Content
description: Create a comprehensive draft of the new README.md file, ensuring it covers all required sections for developer onboarding and project understanding.
details: Write a new README.md draft that includes: 1) Project title and concise description, 2) Key features and technology stack, 3) Step-by-step setup and installation instructions (including prerequisites, cloning, installing dependencies, environment variables, and running the dev server), 4) Overview of the project structure (main directories and their purposes), 5) Deployment instructions (with focus on Vercel), 6) Badges, links to documentation, and clear markdown formatting. Proofread for clarity and accuracy. Reference the PRD and repository analysis for all content.
test_strategy: Review the draft for completeness, clarity, and accuracy. Ensure all sections are present and markdown formatting is correct. Peer review for typos and structure.

title: Validate Setup and Instructions
description: Test the new README.md by following its setup and installation steps from a clean environment to ensure accuracy and completeness.
details: Clone the repository into a fresh environment. Follow the README.md instructions exactly: install prerequisites, clone the repo, install dependencies, set up environment variables, and run the development server. Note any missing steps, unclear instructions, or errors encountered. Update the draft as needed to address any issues found during validation.
test_strategy: Successful local setup and running of the development server using only the README.md as guidance. Document any discrepancies and confirm they are resolved.

title: Incorporate Visuals and Badges
description: Enhance the README.md with relevant visuals (e.g., screenshot or GIF of the dashboard) and badges (build status, license, framework version).
details: Add a screenshot or GIF of the dashboard UI near the top of the README.md. Include badges for build status, license, and framework version as appropriate. Ensure all images and badges render correctly in markdown and links are valid.
test_strategy: Preview the README.md in GitHub or a markdown viewer to confirm visuals and badges display correctly and links work.

title: Finalize and Commit Updated README.md
description: Finalize the improved README.md, ensuring all feedback and validation results are incorporated, and commit the changes to the repository.
details: Incorporate any final edits based on validation and peer review. Ensure the README.md is well-formatted, comprehensive, and free of errors. Commit the updated README.md to the repository with a clear commit message (e.g., 'docs: enhance README with setup, features, and deployment instructions').
test_strategy: Review the committed README.md in the repository for completeness and formatting. Confirm all sections are present and up to date.
